description: Phase 3.2 D-15 / LANG-06: sentence-splitter cases shared by src/lib/rag/lang/sentences.ts and its sidecar twin (plan 03.2-23). Each case splits text by the sentence_end characters of language's pack (runs of sentence ends count once; closing quotes, brackets and combining marks stay with the sentence; in a spaced script a sentence end needs whitespace after it, which is dropped; whitespace-only pieces are dropped). With budget_tokens null, expect_segments are the sentences. With a number, the sentences are packed greedily, joined with the language's joiner (nothing for zh, one space for en and it), into segments of at most budget_tokens cl100k_base tokens, and a sentence longer than the budget is cut by tokens without splitting a surrogate pair or a letter from its combining mark. Texts are neutral synthetic sentences.

cases.text: 第一句话在这里；它还没有结束。第二句话也在这里！第三句话呢？
expect_segments: 第一句话在这里；它还没有结束。
第二句话也在这里！
第三句话呢？

cases.name: en_semicolon_not_an_end
cases.text: The first sentence is here; it continues. The second one ends! Does the third? Yes.

Yes.

cases.name: it_semicolon_not_an_end

expect_segments: La prima frase è qui; continua ancora.
